official_definition: Digivolution: Condition - (Start of Your Attack Step) By returning this Spirit to your Hand, summon a Condition "Champion" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Digivolution] or [Digivolution: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Digivolution]", "give [Digivolution]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
